## SK Hynix Expands South Korea Domestic Output to Meet AI Memory Demand

SK Hynix committing to domestic capacity expansion is a demand-confidence signal for AI memory — it supports the AI infrastructure capex thesis and provides a cycle-timing data point, though the HBM4 yield challenge from Samsung (cluster 946b26d483e77185) means SK Hynix may be expanding into a more competitive supply landscape.

- SK Hynix is expanding production capacity domestically in South Korea, explicitly to satisfy AI memory demand, per UPI.
- The decision to expand domestic output is a supply-side confirmation that AI HBM demand is strong enough to justify new capacity commitments.
- No specific capacity volumes, investment amounts, or completion timelines are given in the headline.
- The expansion is supply-commitment evidence consistent with SK Hynix's HBM leadership positioning, even as Samsung challenges on HBM4 yields.
